Name: bUse24Clock
Comment: If the 24 hours clock should be used or the 12 hours clock

Name: bUseLeadingZero
Comment: If a zero should be added to every number if they are not having 2 digits. Only works for the time, not the date.

Name: bUseCustomCursor
Comment: If you want to use the custom cursor when hovering over the area

Name: sDateString
Comment: This is the date string found ingame. For more information check: https://github.com/users/Fallen01135/projects/3?pane=issue&itemId=200072401

Name: bActivateLeftStick
Comment: If the left stick should be able to be used to select the time

Name: fDPadInitialDelay
Comment: The time someone needs to hold the button before the time start scrolling

Name: fDPadRepeatRate
Comment: How fast the time should scroll when the button is held

Name: bExtraLogging
Comment: If additional logging should be used
